routing.query: aplicar textura na face do cubo
mover a camera com o mouse
quanto custa a geracao de um sprite

invariants.why: the faces differ by UV, not by material; reintroducing a six-material array re-invites per-face art and the double shading that comes with it
the group order is still what the UV writer walks; getting it wrong puts art on the wrong side the moment anyone indexes it again
rotating the mesh with the camera is only lossless because the cube maps onto itself
48x53 textures are only safe under WebGL2 with clamped wrapping and no mipmaps
geometry is shared by sprite proportion; allocating one per block would multiply GPU buffers for identical data
the procedural material is shared across blocks and scenes; disposing it blanks every other block with that hue
the preview must not write depth or it shadows the next frame's raycast
